slug: 2019-10-01 E-Government Systems Interoperability Challenges - Public Sector in Rwanda (Mugumya, MSc thesis)

facts.fact: A 2019 MSc survey of eight Rwandan public agencies (24 interviews) found 88% of challenges were organizational, including no common standards, guidelines, interoperability framework or enterprise architecture, and recommended publishing an eGIF; the date is the thesis's published date, October 2019.

The same 2019 survey found 96% of challenges were constitutional and legal, with no law obliging agencies to interoperate and integration left to each agency's own initiative; dated by the thesis's published date, October 2019.

systems.tiers: Seven integration points with agencies including MINALOC, LODA, City of Kigali, RLMUA, RURA, RDB, MIFOTRA
